Admin actions: workstation quarantined, outbound C2 traffic blocked, user credential reset, automated remediation playbook executed to eradicate beacon.
Post‑remediation verification confirmed no residual Cobalt Strike activity; host returned to production.

arguments.summary: Critical malware incident involving a Cobalt Strike beacon operating as an in-memory payload injected into svchost.exe on an engineering workstation (WS-ENG-015). The beacon communicated via DNS queries to randomly generated subdomains of cdn-metrics.cloud, using IP 185.220.101.42. The incident was detected by EDR and contained through isolation, process termination, credential reset, and automated remediation.

Workstation WS-ENG-015 isolated from network.
Firewall rule added to block DNS queries to *.cdn-metrics.cloud and IP 185.220.101.42.
Malicious svchost.exe process terminated on WS-ENG-015.
Full endpoint scan initiated on WS-ENG-015.
Compromised user credentials for k.nakamura reset and MFA re‑enrolled.
Ansible remediation run: removed persistence artifacts, cleared scheduled tasks and registry run keys.
Workstation restored to production after verification of clean state.
